messages:
Maya Chen: Midweek idea — Wed 7pm: Taco + Terrarium + Trivia on the rooftop? Low-key. Bring plant cuttings if you want to swap. Thoughts?
Samir: Love it. I can bring a taco pack from La Taqueria. :taco: 
Leo: Rooftop sounds great but weather check — alternate Conf Room B with projector for trivia?
Anya: I'm in. Happy to run trivia rounds (5 Qs each). Topic mix: pop-culture + weird facts. :nerd_face: 
Dave: I can bring soil, small pots, and a couple of succulents for swaps.
Maya Chen: Nice — can folks RSVP in-thread with this tiny format so I can tally food: `Yes (tacos) / Yes (no tacos) / Maybe` + # of people + dietary notes?
Samir: Yes (tacos) / 1 / vegan option pls (I can pick tofu tacos).
Leo: Yes / +1 / no prefs. Also can we do a quick audio check beforehand? I have a bluetooth speaker.
Anya: Yes / solo. I'll prepare 3 trivia rounds: "Bad Tech Names", "80s one-hit wonders", and "Food Emoji Bonanza".
calendar-bot: Event created — "Taco Terrarium & Trivia" • Wed 2024-10-16 19:00 • Location: Rooftop (alt: Conf Room B). RSVP in thread.
Maya Chen: If rain, Conf Room B + projector. @Samir can you grab biodegradable plates/utensils?
Samir: Yep — plates, napkins, forks. I can also bring a small speaker if needed.
Leo: Quick ask — someone bring a deck/board? If trivia needs filler we can do charades or cards.
Anya: I got index cards + markers for scorekeeping.
Dave: Plant-swap mini rules: label cuttings & soil type, no pests pls 😂
Maya Chen: Perfect. I'll drop a 10am poll tomorrow for rooftop vs Conf Room B and update the event.
Samir: :raised_hands: Count me in.
Leo: :party_parrot: Can't wait!
